card.name: The "ut" in in utero
card.fires_on: The "ut" piece in the Latin phrase "in utero", usually in "in utero exposure" in pregnancy and neonatal warnings. It also fires weakly on "ing" in "imputing".

modes.label: in utero exposure
modes.description: The "ut" after "in" (or "in-") in "in utero exposure to [drug]" in label text on pregnancy and infants.
modes.example: A CBC should be obtained in neonates with in<< ut>>ero exposure to TYRUKO.

modes.label: Other word ending
modes.description: A rare case where the pole fires on the "ing" ending of "imputing" in general prose.
modes.example: jorative, imput<<ing>> one-sidedness—burst on the scene
